points.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, realistic Android mobile app screen redesign for the existing Chinese exam-learning app 考匠 (AceExam), focusing on remaining AI points and transaction records. Direction A: calm, readable, compact premium product UI, NOT ornate concept art. Full flat app screenshot, tall portrait, no phone hardware, no angled perspective, no external caption, no watermark. Existing design language: warm nearly white background #F6F8FC, white cards with 24dp soft corners, restrained cobalt blue #2861F2, muted lavender, mint and warm amber only for semantic small icons and status. NO gradients, NO 3D coins, NO huge branding, NO charts, NO certificate picker. Crisp natural Chinese system sans typography; body at least 16sp, generous but purposeful 8/16/24 spacing, no huge empty areas. Numerals should be tabular, aligned, not squeezed. Every glyph visibly centered in icon badges. Status and gesture safe areas, 48dp touch targets. Screen layout: safe top status bar 9:41, simple back chevron, centered page title '积分', subtle refresh icon at right. Hero balance card with a small blue sparkle badge and label '可用积分', large clear number '64.280' and modest baseline '积分'. One lower inset row shows small amber dot and '预扣中' with '1.600 积分' right aligned; visual separator and adequate breathing room between number and caption. Under hero a compact single entry row info outline icon '积分与费用说明' and chevron, collapsed by default, NOT a paragraph wall. Then section heading '使用记录', segmented control '全部' '已扣除' '已退回', first selected with light-blue pill. Group label '今天'. Three soft white transaction rows, each with 44dp softly rounded colored outline-icon tile, title and date/model under it, right-aligned amount and textual status: row1 blue book icon '题目详解', '14:32 · DeepSeek Flash', amount '−0.240', status '已结算'; row2 mint return arrow 'AI 出题', '13:16 · 任务未完成', amount '0 积分', status '预扣 2.800 已退回'; row3 amber clock 'AI 学习计划', '12:08 · 正在处理', amount '1.600', status '预扣中'. A small right chevron on each row communicates opening transaction detail. At bottom a quiet full-width outlined button '加载更多记录'. Use consistent visual baseline, readable full labels, never clip Chinese words, rounded status tags and understated dividers. All displayed amounts are illustrative UI data, not fixed prices. This screen should feel useful, professional and implementable in React Native.

checkIn.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high fidelity portrait Android app screenshot of the Chinese exam-learning app 考匠 (AceExam), the '每日签到' screen. This must match the recently approved understated points-page visual language: almost white very pale blue #F6F8FC background, softly rounded white cards 24dp corners, deep navy text, cobalt #2861F2 primary button, small muted mint/amber/lavender accents, simple beautifully centered thin outline icons. Flat real implementable React Native product UI, NOT concept art or promotional poster. No phone frame, no 3D, no coins, no gradients, no excessive blank space. Chinese system sans with clear 16sp body, 22sp page heading, refined aligned tabular numerals, excellent padding around badges and icons. Status bar and bottom gesture safe area, 48dp or larger touch targets. At top 9:41 status bar, back chevron at left, centered title '每日签到', small outline list icon at right opening points details. Under header a modest small date label '10月26日 · 星期一'. Main white hero card: small pale-blue circular calendar-check icon at top, small label '今日可领取', focused number '+66' with small baseline unit '积分', ample but not oversized spacing. Small soft lavender badge '当前 SVIP' and quiet text '按当前会员额度领取'. Below a blue full-width rounded primary button '签到领取 66 积分', then a short secondary line with amber clock icon '今日领取，当日有效'. Beneath hero a compact white balance row: sparkle icon on light blue rounded tile, label '可用积分', right aligned '64.280' with small unit '积分' and chevron; visually less prominent than reward. Next white section headed '每日签到额度'. A clean 2 by 2 information grid of four tiers, no radio buttons and no implication the user can switch tiers for free: '免费' and '1 积分 / 天'; 'VIP' and '33 积分 / 天'; 'SVIP' and '66 积分 / 天' with subtle blue border and small tag '当前'; 'SSVIP' and '133 积分 / 天'. Use quiet warm amber crown accent for VIP and restrained lavender sparkle for SVIP, not metallic. Under this a white compact disclosure row info icon '签到规则' right chevron, CLOSED. One short small yet readable note outside the card: '每天手动领取，不再整笔发放月积分'. No calendar, no streak counter, no weekly bonus, no 7-day reward, no invented historical totals, no giant brand logo, no exam certificate chooser, no advertisement. Render all quoted Chinese text accurately and completely, never clip or squeeze text. A pragmatic, polished screen with slightly varied semantic color accents and balanced vertical density. Displayed balance is illustrative UI sample data, not a real account balance.
